traits.note: FNA vol. 28, Hypnaceae (Schofield, Buck and Ireland; efloras, read 2026-11-05): plants in tufts or mats, often lustrous; stems creeping to erect, irregularly to regularly pinnate; leaves often falcate-secund, ovate-lanceolate; seta elongate; capsule inclined, horizontal or sometimes erect.
